{{Quote|It's been my experience&mdash;such as it is&mdash;that on some level, one usually knows the difference between right and wrong. Sometimes you pretend to yourself that you don't, so you can choose to eat that cream-fat puff-pie you ought to skip, but deep down, you know you shouldn't.|Uli|<ref name="medstar" />}}
'''Puff-pie''' was a rich [[Foodstuff/Legends|dessert]] made with fattening [[Cream/Legends|cream]].<ref name="medstar" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]'', which include the mention of puff-[[Pie/Legends|pie]], to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the [[Doctor/Legends|surgeon]] [[Kornell Divini|Uli]] compared choosing between right and wrong to choosing whether or not to [[Diet/Legends|eat]] a cream-fat puff-pie that ought to be skipped. [[Gender/Legends|His]] friend, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], noted that gorging on dessert could not be fairly compared to evildoing on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] scale. Uli responded that it perhaps depended on the dessert in question.<ref name="medstar" />

==Behind the scenes==
Puff-pie was mentioned in ''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]'', a novel written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] as the second book in the [[MedStar Duology|''MedStar'' Duology]].<ref name="medstar" />
